items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: And I was on a ship and Bill Lee came on the ship. And he had a clarinet. So I used to sing and he would play. And finally we decided I should get a clarinet and we'd play together.

ctx.x: And did they have any jazz bands over there when you were growing up?

No, I never even thought of jazz whatsoever. Until, well, I guess my first interest was in singing. And I was on a ship and Bill Lee came on the ship. And he had a clarinet. So I used to sing and he would play. And finally we decided I should get a clarinet and we'd play together. That's the way I made my entry into the study of music.
